typography.body_font_source: self-hosted (not on Google Fonts) — files in carrossel/*/fonts/rawline-600.woff, rawline-700.woff, @font-face declared per-export

style.title_rule: Bebas Neue — accent word/phrase within a title uses accent_gradient (bottom #915200 to top #ffba00), rest of title is #FFFFFF. Go big and tight: font-size 140px, line-height 1.0, letter-spacing 0px at 1080px canvas width (scale proportionally for other widths). Bump size further before adding a 3rd line — a 2-line title that fills more vertical space reads better than a smaller 3-line one.
style.detail_rule: Tags, dividers, quote bars, numbers, small labels/icons use solid accent #ffba00
style.top_tag: Every slide's top-left tag is the literal wordmark "H . A . M . M . E . R" (HAMMER method), solid accent color — not a per-slide topic label.

type_scale_1080_canvas.note: Everything scaled up from an earlier pass that read fine on the export file but went illegible once compressed by Instagram's feed/story display — always sanity-check a design at actual Instagram display size (roughly 500-600px wide on a phone), not just at the 4x export resolution. See feedback-prleofelix-carousel-typography memory.
